title: 2D Potential Flow (FEM)
desc.equation: Two-dimensional incompressible, irrotational flow: the stream function ψ satisfies the Laplace equation, and the velocities are its derivatives:
desc.domain: Rectangular channel minus the obstacle centered at (c_x, c_y): a cylinder of radius r, or a NACA 0012 or NACA 4412 airfoil with chord c and angle of attack α. Triangular mesh generated over a grid of n_x × n_y nodes, with the obstacle boundary nodes added:
desc.bc.outlet: Outlet (x = L), natural condition of the formulation:
desc.method: Finite Element Method (Galerkin) with linear triangular elements; the sparse system is solved once. Velocities from the gradient of the interpolated ψ; pressure coefficient from Bernoulli's equation,
desc.method.forces: lift and drag by integrating −C_p over the obstacle surface.
desc.reference: Cylinder in an unconfined uniform stream (classical potential theory), with θ measured from the front stagnation point:
desc.reference.note: There is no analytical reference for the airfoils; the simulation shows only the numerical result.
py.val.cp_title: Validation: C_p on the cylinder surface (theory: C_p = 1 − 4 sin²θ)
py.res.title: Aerodynamic results
